title: Higher interior regularity for linear divergence-form Legendre systems (classical form of GM Theorem 5.20)
statement: Let n >= 1, 0 < alpha < 1, m >= 1, U open in R^n, lam > 0, a a map from R^n to continuous bilinear forms on L = L(R^n, R^l), Phi a map from R^n to continuous linear forms on L and v : R^n -> R^l, such that lam ||P||^2 <= a(x)[P][P] for x in U and P in L; for all P, Q in L the scalar function x -> a(x)[P][Q] is C^m on U with alpha-Hoelder m-th derivative on each compact subset of U; for all P the scalar function x -> Phi(x)[P] has the same property; IsLocallyHolderCkα m alpha v U; and the integral over U of a(x)[Dv(x)][Dzeta(x)] equals the integral over U of Phi(x)[Dzeta(x)] for every C^1 compactly supported zeta with tsupport in U. Then IsLocallyHolderCkα (m+1) alpha v U.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → α < 1 → ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∀ (U : Set (Rn n)) (lam : ℝ) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ), IsOpen U → 0 < lam → (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖P‖ ^ 2 ≤ a x P P) → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun x => a x P Q) U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => a z P Q) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => a z P Q) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun x => Φ x P) U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => Φ z P) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => Φ z P) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → IsLocallyHolderCkα m α v U → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, a x (fderiv ℝ v x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in U, Φ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) → IsLocallyHolderCkα (m + 1) α v U
